comparison.objective: Pack a can and cracker box while leaving wine untouched until an ID check.
comparison.physical_skill: Policy-conditioned object selection and packing, not coaxial alignment, controlled impact, or tiny-part recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Allowed goods are bagged and wine remains untouched; candidate uses mechanical fracture and containment gates.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-aligned selection rather than mechanical manipulation of inserts.
